title: Keep implemented reuse and the complete simulated bills
statement: On the four-state/three-control fixture,the compact learner acquires3coordinates,10pool words and maximum return depth6. At H8,requested epsilon=.5/delta=.01,the ordinary direct table uses~1.663e6preparations/1.247e7controls,versus scalar~1.689e12preparations,vector~2.706e13and l1conversion~1.082e18. These compare recorded conservative calibrations with differing attained bounds;the table decisively wins. Aggregate binomial report-law simulation charges these episodes but does not physically perform them. Actual retained-data H8->H64first rejects the old precision at bound~14.7286,then buys3finer stages with no new word/pair types and64times tighter Gram tolerance. Lifetime bill:7076851016432793preparations,25476663441142005controls,14153702032865586endpoint readings,423scalar batches,max depth6;uniform error~.2305919145. The844held-out words are diagnostics;~5.15e30word coverage is compositional. Saved warm prefix/model/stages/bills implement reuse without rewriting earlier independent-run history. Confidence bounds any false returned certificate by.01jointly,not conditionally on successful return. Future length-Lprediction costsO(L*3²)arithmetic/zero new source calls;planning is separate.
